name: dat_non_python_glsl
why: A GLSL pixel DAT (extension 'frag', no language param) whose shader text happens to contain Python-looking words. It is specimen content, not a Python execution surface: scanner.py skipped non-Python DATs, scanner-ts token-scanned every dat_content and false-flagged shaders (issue #94 review).

operators.name: glsl_pixel
